 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 2 21-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioners have filed the instant application for the following relief(s):
"(i) For commanding the respondent authorities not to forcefully dispossess the petitioners and to construct any Government building over the raiyati land of the Petitioners without acquisition of the same, if occasion so arises, which is being utilised by them as a Tea Garden as well as for horticultural purposes, situated at Mauza-Poakhali, Thana No.119, Thana-Pothia, District-Kishanganj appertaining to Plot No.174, 180, 181 and 182 in Khata No.16 having total area of 1.48 acres.
(ii) And/or in alternative the petitioners are bound to be compensated suitably by taking recourse to the provisions of the Right to fair Patna High Court CWJC No.3639 of 2023(2) dt.21-03-2023 compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, if the aforesaid land of the petitioners are required to be acquired for public purposes.

sentences.text: (iii) Also for commanding the respondents to restrain themselves from interfering with the peaceful possession of the petitioners on the aforesaid land of the petitioners.
(iv) Also for any other appropriate relief(s) for which petitioners are found to be entitled either in the eye of law or in the facts and circumstances of the case."

It is the case of the petitioners that without taking any steps for acquisition of land in accordance with law and without having acquired the same, the respondents are threatening to take forceful possession and making construction on 1.48 acres of land described in paragraph no.9 of the writ application as also paragraph no.1 of the application quoted herein above.
Learned counsel for the State prays for four weeks time for filing counter affidavit in the case.
It is directed that during pendency of this application, the respondents will not dispossess the petitioners from the land which is subject matter of the instant application.

On filing of the counter affidavit, in case the application is not taken up, learned counsel for the respondents Patna High Court CWJC No.3639 of 2023(2) dt.21-03-2023 will have liberty to mention this case for out of turn hearing.

(Partha Sarthy, J) avinash/-
